verses.en: Be ye therefore followers of God, as dear children;
verses.pt: Sede pois imitadores de Deus, como filhos amados;
verses.en_web: Be therefore imitators of God, as beloved children.
verses.en_bbe: Let it then be your desire to be like God, as well-loved children;

verses.en: And walk in love, as Christ also hath loved us, and hath given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweetsmelling savour.
verses.pt: e andai em amor, como Cristo também vos amou, e se entregou a si mesmo por nós, como oferta e sacrifício a Deus, em cheiro suave.
verses.en_web: Walk in love, even as Christ also loved you, and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet-smelling fragrance.
verses.en_bbe: And be living in love, even as Christ had love for you, and gave himself up for us, an offering to God for a perfume of a sweet smell.

verses.en: But fornication, and all uncleanness, or covetousness, let it not be once named among you, as becometh saints;
verses.pt: Mas a prostituição, e toda sorte de impureza ou cobiça, nem sequer se nomeie entre vós, como convém a santos,
verses.en_web: But sexual immorality, and all uncleanness, or covetousness, let it not even be mentioned among you, as becomes saints;
verses.en_bbe: But evil acts of the flesh and all unclean things, or desire for others' property, let it not even be named among you, as is right for saints;

verses.en: Neither filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not convenient: but rather giving of thanks.
verses.pt: nem baixeza, nem conversa tola, nem gracejos indecentes, coisas essas que não convêm; mas antes ações de graças.
verses.en_web: nor filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not appropriate; but rather giving of thanks.
verses.en_bbe: And let there be no low behaviour, or foolish talk, or words said in sport, which are not right, but in place of them the giving of praise.

verses.en: For this ye know, that no whoremonger, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, hath any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.
verses.pt: Porque bem sabeis isto: que nenhum devasso, ou impuro, ou avarento, o qual é idólatra, tem herança no reino de Cristo e de Deus.
verses.en_web: Know this for sure, that no sexually immoral person, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, has any inheritance in the Kingdom of Christ and God.
verses.en_bbe: Being certain of this, that no man who gives way to the passions of the flesh, no unclean person, or one who has desire for the property of others, or who gives worship to images, has any heritage in the kingdom of Christ and God.

verses.en: Let no man deceive you with vain words: for because of these things cometh the wrath of God upon the children of disobedience.
verses.pt: Ninguém vos engane com palavras vãs; porque por estas coisas vem a ira de Deus sobre os filhos da desobediência.
verses.en_web: Let no one deceive you with empty words. For because of these things, the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.
verses.en_bbe: Do not be turned from the right way by foolish words; for because of these things the punishment of God comes on those who do not put themselves under him.

verses.en: Be not ye therefore partakers with them.
verses.pt: Portanto não sejais participantes com eles;
verses.en_web: Therefore don’t be partakers with them.
verses.en_bbe: Have no part with such men;

verses.en: For ye were sometimes darkness, but now are ye light in the Lord: walk as children of light:
verses.pt: pois outrora éreis trevas, mas agora sois luz no Senhor; andai como filhos da luz
verses.en_web: For you were once darkness, but are now light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,
verses.en_bbe: For you at one time were dark, but now are light in the Lord: let your behaviour be that of children of light

verses.en: (For the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth;)
verses.pt: (pois o fruto da luz está em toda a bondade, e justiça e verdade),
verses.en_web: for the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth,
verses.en_bbe: (Because the fruit of the light is in all righteousness and in everything which is good and true),

verses.en: Proving what is acceptable unto the Lord.
verses.pt: provando o que é agradável ao Senhor;
verses.en_web: proving what is well pleasing to the Lord.
verses.en_bbe: Testing by experience what is well-pleasing to the Lord;

verses.en: And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather reprove them.
verses.pt: e não vos associeis às obras infrutuosas das trevas, antes, porém, condenai-as;
verses.en_web: Have no fellowship with the unfruitful deeds of darkness, but rather even reprove them.
verses.en_bbe: And have no company with the works of the dark, which give no fruit, but make their true quality clear;

verses.en: For it is a shame even to speak of those things which are done of them in secret.
verses.pt: porque as coisas feitas por eles em oculto, até o dizê-las é vergonhoso.
verses.en_web: For the things which are done by them in secret, it is a shame even to speak of.
verses.en_bbe: For the things which are done by them in secret it is shame even to put into words.

verses.en: But all things that are reproved are made manifest by the light: for whatsoever doth make manifest is light.
verses.pt: Mas todas estas coisas, sendo condenadas, se manifestam pela luz, pois tudo o que se manifesta é luz.
verses.en_web: But all things, when they are reproved, are revealed by the light, for everything that reveals is light.
verses.en_bbe: But all things, when their true quality is seen, are made clear by the light: because everything which is made clear is light.

verses.en: Wherefore he saith, Awake thou that sleepest, and arise from the dead, and Christ shall give thee light.
verses.pt: Pelo que diz: Desperta, tu que dormes, e levanta-te dentre os mortos, e Cristo te iluminará.
verses.en_web: Therefore he says, “Awake, you who sleep, and arise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”
verses.en_bbe: For this reason he says, Be awake, you who are sleeping, and come up from among the dead, and Christ will be your light.

verses.en: See then that ye walk circumspectly, not as fools, but as wise,
verses.pt: Portanto, vede diligentemente como andais, não como néscios, mas como sábios,
verses.en_web: Therefore watch carefully how you walk, not as unwise, but as wise;
verses.en_bbe: Take care then how you are living, not as unwise, but as wise;

verses.en: Redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
verses.pt: usando bem cada oportunidade, porquanto os dias são maus.
verses.en_web: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
verses.en_bbe: Making good use of the time, because the days are evil.

verses.en: Wherefore be ye not unwise, but understanding what the will of the Lord is.
verses.pt: Por isso, não sejais insensatos, mas entendei qual seja a vontade do Senhor.
verses.en_web: Therefore don’t be foolish, but understand what the will of the Lord is.
verses.en_bbe: For this reason, then, do not be foolish, but be conscious of the Lord's pleasure.

verses.en: And be not drunk with wine, wherein is excess; but be filled with the Spirit;
verses.pt: E não vos embriagueis com vinho, no qual há devassidão, mas enchei-vos do Espírito,
verses.en_web: Don’t be drunken with wine, in which is dissipation, but be filled with the Spirit,
verses.en_bbe: And do not take overmuch wine by which one may be overcome, but be full of the Spirit;

verses.en: Speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;
verses.pt: falando entre vós em salmos, hinos, e cânticos espirituais, cantando e salmodiando ao Senhor no vosso coração,
verses.en_web: speaking to one another in psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs; singing, and making melody in your heart to the Lord;
verses.en_bbe: Joining with one another in holy songs of praise and of the Spirit, using your voice in songs and making melody in your heart to the Lord;

verses.en: Giving thanks always for all things unto God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ;
verses.pt: sempre dando graças por tudo a Deus, o Pai, em nome de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo,
verses.en_web: giving thanks always concerning all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, to God, even the Father;
verses.en_bbe: Giving praise at all times for all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, to God, even the Father;

verses.en: Submitting yourselves one to another in the fear of God.
verses.pt: sujeitando-vos uns aos outros no temor de Cristo.
verses.en_web: subjecting yourselves to one another in the fear of Christ.
verses.en_bbe: Letting yourselves be ruled by one another in the fear of Christ.

verses.en: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord.
verses.pt: Vós, mulheres, submetei-vos a vossos maridos, como ao Senhor;
verses.en_web: Wives, be subject to your own husbands, as to the Lord.
verses.en_bbe: Wives, be under the authority of your husbands, as of the Lord.

verses.en: For the husband is the head of the wife, even as Christ is the head of the church: and he is the saviour of the body.
verses.pt: porque o marido é a cabeça da mulher, como também Cristo é a cabeça da igreja, sendo ele próprio o Salvador do corpo.
verses.en_web: For the husband is the head of the wife, as Christ also is the head of the assembly, being himself the savior of the body.
verses.en_bbe: For the husband is the head of the wife, as Christ is the head of the church, being himself the saviour of the body.

verses.en: Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing.
verses.pt: Mas, assim como a igreja está sujeita a Cristo, assim também as mulheres o sejam em tudo a seus maridos.
verses.en_web: But as the assembly is subject to Christ, so let the wives also be to their own husbands in everything.
verses.en_bbe: And as the church is under Christ's authority, so let wives be under the rule of their husbands in all things.

verses.en: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it;
verses.pt: Vós, maridos, amai a vossas mulheres, como também Cristo amou a igreja, e a si mesmo se entregou por ela,
verses.en_web: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the assembly, and gave himself up for it;
verses.en_bbe: Husbands, have love for your wives, even as Christ had love for the church, and gave himself for it;

verses.en: That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word,
verses.pt: a fim de a santificar, tendo-a purificado com a lavagem da água, pela palavra,
verses.en_web: that he might sanctify it, having cleansed it by the washing of water with the word,
verses.en_bbe: So that he might make it holy, having made it clean with the washing of water by the word,

verses.en: That he might present it to himself a glorious church, not having spot, or wrinkle, or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish.
verses.pt: para apresentá-la a si mesmo igreja gloriosa, sem mácula, nem ruga, nem qualquer coisa semelhante, mas santa e irrepreensível.
verses.en_web: that he might present the assembly to himself gloriously, not having spot or wrinkle or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without defect.
verses.en_bbe: And might take it for himself, a church full of glory, not having one mark or fold or any such thing; but that it might be holy and complete.

verses.en: So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies. He that loveth his wife loveth himself.
verses.pt: Assim devem os maridos amar a suas próprias mulheres, como a seus próprios corpos. Quem ama a sua mulher, ama-se a si mesmo.
verses.en_web: Even so husbands also ought to love their own wives as their own bodies. He who loves his own wife loves himself.
verses.en_bbe: Even so it is right for husbands to have love for their wives as for their bodies. He who has love for his wife has love for himself:

verses.en: For no man ever yet hated his own flesh; but nourisheth and cherisheth it, even as the Lord the church:
verses.pt: Pois nunca ninguém aborreceu a sua própria carne, antes a nutre e preza, como também Cristo à igreja;
verses.en_web: For no man ever hated his own flesh; but nourishes and cherishes it, even as the Lord also does the assembly;
verses.en_bbe: For no man ever had hate for his flesh; but he gives it food and takes care of it, even as Christ does for the church;

verses.en: For we are members of his body, of his flesh, and of his bones.
verses.pt: porque somos membros do seu corpo.
verses.en_web: because we are members of his body, of his flesh and bones.
verses.en_bbe: Because we are parts of his body.

verses.en: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall be joined unto his wife, and they two shall be one flesh.
verses.pt: Por isso deixará o homem a seu pai e a sua mãe, e se unirá à sua mulher, e serão os dois uma só carne.
verses.en_web: “For this cause a man will leave his father and mother, and will be joined to his wife. The two will become one flesh.”
verses.en_bbe: For this cause will a man go away from his father and mother and be joined to his wife, and the two will become one flesh.

verses.en: This is a great mystery: but I speak concerning Christ and the church.
verses.pt: Grande é este mistério, mas eu falo em referência a Cristo e à igreja.
verses.en_web: This mystery is great, but I speak concerning Christ and of the assembly.
verses.en_bbe: This is a great secret: but my words are about Christ and the church.

verses.en: Nevertheless let every one of you in particular so love his wife even as himself; and the wife see that she reverence her husband.
verses.pt: Todavia também vós, cada um de per si, assim ame a sua própria mulher como a si mesmo, e a mulher reverencie a seu marido.
verses.en_web: Nevertheless each of you must also love his own wife even as himself; and let the wife see that she respects her husband.
verses.en_bbe: But do you, everyone, have love for his wife, even as for himself; and let the wife see that she has respect for her husband.
